name: fight_act1_grove_gate
title: Act 1 fight: the goblin raid on the Emerald Grove gate
about: Fight (family 1) with allies: the goblin raiders at the Emerald Grove's gate, fought beside the tiefling defenders, the first large Act 1 fight. claude-run-2 S007 won it at level 1-2 with a three-member party.

note.where: The road to the Emerald Grove's gate, out of combat; fighting can be heard ahead.
note.objective: Help the defenders drive off the goblins at the gate.

character.name: Tav
character.brief: A level-headed half-elf paladin (Oath of Devotion), once a Baldur's Gate city watch sergeant: protects the weak, keeps promises, distrusts mind magic and anyone who offers easy power.
